title: Atomic all-or-nothing Storage Space batch-create contract
approvedBy: Product Owner (explicit approval recorded in IMP-MD-005 evidence)
approvedDelta: One storage-spaces:batch-create request is one logical mutation intent and is atomic all-or-nothing. Validate the complete batch before commit; any mandatory failure rolls back all Storage Space rows and all business, audit, journal, idempotency and outbox effects. Exact-key/same-payload replay is safe; same-key/different-payload reuse conflicts. Partial success is prohibited.
apiCompatibility: Backward-compatible clarification within the existing /api/v1 endpoint; no route, DTO or schema migration.
rvmImpact: Register FD-75 and TA-D234 and map only the executed IMP-MD-005 atomic batch/idempotency/rollback tests.
testImpact: Complete success, complete rollback for any invalid element or injected effect failure, no partial effects, exact replay and idempotency mismatch conflict.
